evals.prompt: I need to set up Apifox CLI for the first time. How do I authenticate and verify my connection?
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step instructions for getting access token, logging in with apifox login --with-token, and verifying with apifox whoami. Should mention storing token in environment variable for CI/CD.

assertions.text: Recommends storing token in environment variable

evals.prompt: How do I run my API tests in a GitHub Actions workflow? I have a test scenario ID and environment ID.
evals.expected_output: Complete GitHub Actions YAML example using apifox run with --access-token from secrets, specifying scenario ID with -t, environment ID with -e, report formats, and --upload-report. Should include artifact collection.

assertions.text: Provides complete GitHub Actions YAML workflow
Shows test execution with -t and -e flags
Includes report generation and artifact upload

evals.prompt: I want to import my Postman collection into Apifox and then export it as OpenAPI format. What are the commands?
evals.expected_output: Two commands: 1) apifox import --project <id> --format postman --file ./collection.json, 2) apifox export --project <id> --format openapi --output ./openapi.json. Should mention validating the import first.

assertions.text: Provides correct import command with --format postman
Provides correct export command with --format openapi
